Place your favorite couple photos in this folder.
Supported formats: jpg, jpeg, png, webp, gif, avif

The app will automatically detect and display them in the gallery.
You can name them numerically (1.jpg, 2.jpg, 3.jpg...) or with descriptive names (us1.png, couple.jpg, love.webp...).

Images placed here are served at /GalleryPictures/<filename> and will appear in the "Our Little Moments" gallery section on the page.
